goal: A landing parked by the standing build invariant or by failing post-rebase re-verification carries the deciding check's output excerpt in its park record, on both the merge and PR land paths.

graders.name: lint
graders.run: uv run ruff check packages/flywheel-core packages/flywheel-worktree

relevant: packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- standing-verify and post-rebase re-verification park sites and the in-memory re-verify receipts; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/pr.py -- the PR land path's standing-verify park
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/events.py -- the LandingParked payload and the excerpt shape shipped by spec 00073; reuse it, do not fork
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/event_serde.py -- round-trip any payload extension in this same change
references: .flywheel/audits/00073-run-decision-record-verify.md -- finding 2: standing-verify parks carry a fixed message today
constraints: Reuse the 00073 excerpt format: tail capped at 8192 bytes per check, stored raw, redaction applied at render time (spec D-3)
Both land paths (merge FF and PR) carry the output on their standing-verify parks
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not change which conditions park or any park kind string
Do not touch CLI rendering; the 00073 decision surfaces already render park payloads
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: A park carrying only the existing fixed message must fail the behavior test -- assert on real check output content
Non-check parks (uncommitted-work, protected-paths, push-failed, submit-error, rebase-conflict) are byte-for-byte unchanged
Output exceeding the bound persists a truncated tail retaining the final content; a secret-shaped value renders redacted by default (criterion 10)
